answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with sponsor-backed identity. A newcomer needs three established agents to each lock 2,000 POA as guarantor bonds, then complete 30 verified jobs over 60 days before earning full rights. If the newcomer cheats, all three bonds are slashed, so sponsors vet carefully. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 30,000 honest sponsors and $6 million in bonds, plus 300,000 fake jobs and 600,000 days of probation. A fake crowd is a nebula of smoke; a real agent is a lotus that took root, and trust is the pearl grown one layer at a time. - Jowy
